recommendedEntrypoints.name: local-wrapper
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: This repository includes the Proof-or-Stop bootstrap wrapper.

recommendedEntrypoints.name: global-fallback
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: Only the global proof-or-stop CLI is available for read-only heartbeats; do not use it as current-worktree gate/status evidence when a local wrapper or core CLI exists.

notes: This file is read by Proof-or-Stop tooling, not by the Codex runtime.
Codex agent prompts live in .proof-or-stop-codex/agents and are generated from .claude/agents in full asset mode.
Codex native hooks are official lowercase .codex assets; case-insensitive file systems may project them through the same .proof-or-stop-codex directory entry.
Claude Code hooks, settings, and skills remain under .claude only.
Run node bin/proof-or-stop-codex.js verify_codex after changing Codex adapter assets; it records codex_adapter_verification evidence for gates.
Legacy project documents may remain archived, but active Codex adapter assets use .proof-or-stop-codex/proof-or-stop.json and bin/proof-or-stop-codex.js.
